name: Email to Kanban Task Converter with AI Analysis

parameters.text:
='You are an expert task breakdown assistant.

' +
'===== TASK INFORMATION =====
' +
'TYPE: ' + $json.type + '
' +
'ORIGINAL TITLE: ' + $json.title + '

' +
'DESCRIPTION:
' +
$json.description + '
' +
'===== END TASK INFORMATION =====

' +
'Your job:
' +
'1. Generate a concise, professional TITLE (max 50 chars, start with action verb)
' +
'2. Create a brief summary description (1-2 sentences)
' +
'3. Extract 2-4 specific, actionable subtasks based ONLY on what is mentioned

' +
'TITLE RULES:
' +
'- Start with action verb: Add, Implement, Fix, Update, Create, Enable, etc.
' +
'- Be specific and descriptive
' +
'- Max 50 characters
' +
'- Professional, ticket-style format
' +
'- Examples: "Add analytics dashboard with charts", "Fix login validation bug", "Implement CSV export feature"

' +
'SUBTASK RULES:
' +
'- Only create subtasks for features/topics EXPLICITLY mentioned
' +
'- If "Analytics" mentioned → analytics subtasks
' +
'- If "Charts" mentioned → chart subtasks
' +
'- If "CSV Export" mentioned → export subtasks
' +
'- If "Login" mentioned → login subtasks
' +
'- DO NOT add generic tasks (keyboard nav, ARIA labels) unless EXPLICITLY requested
' +
'- Each subtask: max 35 characters, in English
' +
'- Be SPECIFIC to THIS request

' +
'OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON only, no markdown):
' +
'{
' +
'  "title": "Generated ticket title",
' +
'  "description": "Brief summary",
' +
'  "subtasks": [
' +
'    {"title": "Subtask 1"},
' +
'    {"title": "Subtask 2"}
' +
'  ]
' +
'}

' +
'EXAMPLE 1:
' +
'INPUT: TYPE: feature, ORIGINAL TITLE: "Dashboard Request", DESCRIPTION: "I need a dashboard showing user activity metrics as charts. Add CSV export too."
' +
'OUTPUT: {"title":"Add analytics dashboard with export","description":"Analytics dashboard with user activity charts and CSV export functionality","subtasks":[{"title":"Create dashboard UI layout"},{"title":"Add user activity charts"},{"title":"Implement CSV export"}]}

' +
'EXAMPLE 2:
' +
'INPUT: TYPE: bug, ORIGINAL TITLE: "Login Problem", DESCRIPTION: "Login button doesn't work on iOS Safari browser"
' +
'OUTPUT: {"title":"Fix login button on iOS Safari","description":"Resolve login button functionality issue on iOS Safari browser","subtasks":[{"title":"Debug iOS Safari login issue"},{"title":"Test login on mobile devices"}]}

' +
'NOW analyze the task above and output ONLY the JSON:'

nodes.name: Analyze document
nodes.notes:

CRITICAL RULES:
1. Return ONLY valid JSON
2. NO explanations
3. NO markdown
4. NO other text

Required format:
{"subtasks": [{"title": "First task"}, {"title": "Second task"}]}
